KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Hears or says /nj/ for /j/, so jaa (to be full) becomes njaa (hunger).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "jaa". Umesikia neno lipi?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The nasal (n- or m-) before j is soft and quick; a child who does not hear it writes and says the word without it, or adds it where it does not belong, and the meaning changes.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "jaa". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "njaa" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "jaa" ina sauti /j/. "njaa" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (shati where chati is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a chart".

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a chart"." with "shati" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "a chart" ni "chati". "shati" lina maana ya "a shirt".
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "chati" na "shati" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question ""chati" na "shati" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Hapana. "chati" ni a chart, na "shati" ni a shirt.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.wrong_answer: Moyo husukuma damu mwilini kila wakati.
example.correct_answer: Njaa ya Njeri ilijaa njiani, akanywa chai na kula ndizi ndani ya nyumba ndogo.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Moyo husukuma damu mwilini kila wakati." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits the syllable with the nasal wrongly (n-jaa instead of keeping the nasal with its consonant).

example.question: Neno "njaa" lina silabi zipi?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "njaa" lina silabi zipi?" with "n-jaa" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nja-a.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word in the passage.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child reads the first letters and not the meaning.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: A word with a look-alike among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Read the sentence around the word and think what is being done.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na sentensi lilimo, si na jinsi linavyofanana na neno lingine.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word from a nearby sentence that is not about this word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child grabs the first thing the passage says.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: An option taken from another sentence.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Go back to the exact sentence with the word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Rudi kwenye sentensi lenyewe lenye neno hilo. Maana inatoka hapo, si kutoka sentensi ya karibu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks the opposite of the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child finds the idea and then reverses it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: An option with the opposite meaning.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Does the word mean the same thing as your choice?
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Kinyume cha neno si maana yake. Soma tena sentensi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives another character for who did it.

example.question: Nani alimsaidia Wanjiru?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child remembers several names and joins them.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A who-question with another character as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the sentence with the action and see who did it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Rudi kwenye kifungu uone ni nani hasa alifanya kitendo hicho.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from what the passage says.

example.question: Walipika chakula gani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child answers a Kenyan child's common meal rather than the one in the passage.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A question whose answer is not the usual one.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the answer in the passage.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko katika kifungu. Tumia kilichoandikwa, si kile unachokijua kutoka nyumbani.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a small detail as the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child chooses a sentence that is easy to find.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A main-message question with a detail as one option.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Puts events in the order they are told in the question, not in the story.

example.question: Panga matukio kwa mpangilio.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child does not go back to the story.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: Ordering four events from the story.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find each event in the story and see which came first.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Matukio hupangwa kwa jinsi yalivyotokea katika hadithi. Soma tena kila tukio.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a detail from the passage that belongs to another part of the story.

example.question: Wanjiru alichemsha maji katika nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child remembers many details and joins the wrong ones.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A what-or-where question with another detail of the passage as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the exact sentence with the action in the passage.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Kifungu kinataja vitu vingi. Rudi kwenye sentensi sahihi ujue jibu linalolingana na swali.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Explains an organ word with a general word (figo = sehemu ya mwili) that does not tell it from other organs.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "figo" ni nini?
example.correct_answer: kiungo cha ndani kinachochuja damu na kutoa mkojo

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child gives the category, which feels like a definition.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The question "Katika kifungu, "figo" ni nini?" with "sehemu ya mwili" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Ask: which part, and what does it do? A definition names the job.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Eleza kazi yake: figo huchuja damu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini"?
example.correct_answer: Moyo ni kiungo chenye umbo la ngumi, kilicho upande wa kushoto wa kifua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini"?
example.correct_answer: Moyo ni kiungo chenye umbo la ngumi, kilicho upande wa kushoto wa kifua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini"?" with "Moyo ni muhimu sana." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Moyo ni kiungo mdogo lakini chenye nguvu.
example.correct_answer: Moyo ni kiungo kidogo lakini chenye nguvu.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Moyo ni kiungo mdogo lakini chenye nguvu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Moyo ni kiungo chenye umbo la ngumi, kilicho upande wa kushoto wa kifua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Insha "Moyo: Kiungo Muhimu Mwilini" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Uses the singular adjective with a plural noun, or the plural with a singular noun (wanafunzi mzuri).

example.question: Wanafunzi ___ walipata zawadi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: English adjectives do not change with number, so the child keeps one form.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ walipata zawadi." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: Ask "Wanafunzi ni mmoja au wengi? Kivumishi kinaonyesha nini?"
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa hubadilika kulingana na idadi ya nomino. Wanafunzi wengi, kwa hiyo wazuri.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Uses an adjective with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu mkubwa).

example.question: Kitabu ___ kiko mezani.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: The child learned one prefix and uses it for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ kiko mezani." with "mkubwa" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: A gap with a noun of KI-VI and options from other classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi huchukua kiambishi kinacholingana na ngeli ya nomino, kama kitabu kikubwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Picks a noun (ukarimu) where an adjective (mkarimu) is needed.

example.question: Mkulima ___ alipanda mahindi mengi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: The child does not yet tell an adjective from the noun made from it.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Mkulima ___ alipanda mahindi mengi." with "ukarimu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: Options that include the noun and the adjective of the same word.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa huelezea nomino. Ukarimu ni jina la tabia, si kivumishi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Puts the adjective before the noun, English style (mrefu mti, mzuri msichana).

example.question: Ni ipi ni sahihi?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: The English order (a tall tree) carries over.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Kitabu ___ kimepotea.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.feedback: Kivumishi kimilikishi hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachomilikiwa, si ya mwenye kitu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.error: Uses the singular possessive with a plural noun (vitabu changu).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.feedback: Kitu kikiwa wengi, kivumishi hubadilika: kitabu changu, vitabu vyangu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

example.question: Sisi tunapenda shule ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.help: Make a table by class: wangu, changu, langu, yangu, zangu, wangu (mti).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses the greeting or farewell for one person with many (Hujambo for Hamjambo, Kwaheri for Kwa herini).

example.question: Unawasalimia wanafunzi wengi darasani: "___!"

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unawasalimia wanafunzi wengi darasani: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A situation with many people and both greetings among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Kwa mtu mmoja tunasema Hujambo na Kwaheri. Kwa watu wengi tunasema Hamjambo na Kwa herini.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a night farewell in the morning or a morning greeting at night.

example.question: Asubuhi unamwamkia mwalimu: "___, mwalimu."

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not match the greeting to the time of day.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Asubuhi unamwamkia mwalimu: "___, mwalimu."" with "Lala salama" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A situation with a clue word such as asubuhi or usiku.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Asubuhi tunasema Habari za asubuhi. Usiku tunasema Lala salama au Usiku mwema.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting where a farewell is needed, or a farewell where a greeting is needed (Hujambo when leaving).

example.question: Unaondoka na kumwaga mtu mmoja: "___!"

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not ask whether he is arriving or leaving.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unaondoka na kumwaga mtu mmoja: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A leaving situation with a greeting among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Repeats the greeting (Shikamoo) where the reply (Marahaba) is needed.

example.question: Mdogo anamwambia mzee "Shikamoo". Mzee anajibu: "___."

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not know the reply is a different word.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mdogo anamwambia mzee "Shikamoo". Mzee anajibu: "___."" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: The elder's turn with both words among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mdogo husema Shikamoo kwa heshima, na mzee hujibu Marahaba.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts words in order of length, not alphabet.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child looks for the shortest or the first-looking word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Say the alphabet and look at the first letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks only at the first letter and picks any word with the same first letter.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child stops at the first letter when two words begin the same.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: When the first letters match, look at the second letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts the end of the alphabet first.

example.question: Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child mixes first and last.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: A question that asks for the last word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: A comes first and Z comes last.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Reads only the meaning and ignores the other information the dictionary gives (ngeli, aina ya neno, wingi).

example.question: Kamusi inaandika: "kiatu nm (ki-vi) vi-". Herufi "nm" zinaonyesha nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the short forms in an entry.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: The question "Kamusi inaandika: "kiatu nm (ki-vi) vi-". Herufi "nm" zinaonyesha nini?" with "maana ya neno" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Read one entry together and label each part: tahajia, aina, ngeli, wingi, maana.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi huonyesha aina ya neno, ngeli na wingi pia.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?
example.wrong_answer: Mpira wa miguu ni mchezo unaopendwa duniani.
example.correct_answer: Timu yetu ilifunga bao dakika ya mwisho.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?" with "Mpira wa miguu ni mchezo unaopendwa duniani." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?
example.wrong_answer: Timu yetu inafunga bao dakika ya mwisho.
example.correct_answer: Timu yetu ilifunga bao dakika ya mwisho.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?" with "Timu yetu inafunga bao dakika ya mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?
example.wrong_answer: tulisherehekea, tulifunga bao, mechi ilianza, tulifika uwanjani
example.correct_answer: tulifika uwanjani, mechi ilianza, tulifunga bao, tulisherehekea

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?" with "tulisherehekea, tulifunga bao, mechi ilianza, tulifika uwanjani" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Plans with points (vidokezo) that do not belong to the title, or writes the insha without using the points planned.

example.question: Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child lists whatever comes to mind and does not check each point against the title.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni kidokezo kipi hakifai kwa insha "Mechi Isiyosahaulika"?" with "Bei ya sukari imepanda dukani." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Write the title at the top of the plan; tick each point only if it helps to tell that story.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Kila kidokezo kinapaswa kusaidia kusimulia kisa cha anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Puts the prefix of another noun class on the number (vitabu watatu, wanafunzi viwili).

example.question: Vitabu ___ viko mezani.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.cause: The child knows the number words but not that they take the prefix of the noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." with "watatu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.help: A gap with a thing noun and the people form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha ngeli ya nomino: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Writes the bare number (tatu, nne) without the prefix.

example.question: Miti ___ imekatwa.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Adds a class prefix to numbers from six (ng'ombe wasita).

example.question: Baba ana ng'ombe ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Kuanzia sita, nambari haichukui kiambishi cha ngeli: ng'ombe sita, vitabu saba.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Uses the counting number (watatu) where the position is meant (wa tatu), or the reverse.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Nafasi hutumia -a: wa tatu, ya tatu; idadi haina: watatu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Uses the question word of another noun class (vitabu wangapi).

example.question: Vitabu ___ vimepotea?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ vimepotea?" with "wangapi" among the options.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: Kivumishi kiulizi huchukua ngeli ya nomino: wanafunzi wangapi, vitabu vingapi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Uses the plural question word with one noun, or the singular with many (kitabu vipi).

example.question: Kitabu ___ ni chako?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: Kitabu kimoja: kipi. Vitabu vingi: vipi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Confuses -ngapi (how many) with gani (what kind), or the other way.

example.question: Ulikula chakula ___ jana?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.help: A question about kind with -ngapi among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: -ngapi huuliza idadi, -pi huuliza ni ipi kati ya nyingi, gani huuliza aina.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Writes a sentence with a question word and ends it with a full stop.

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: Sentensi yenye kiulizi huishia kwa alama ya kuuliza (?).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.error: Uses amba- with the ending of another noun class (kitabu ambaye).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.feedback: Amba- huchukua mwisho unaolingana na ngeli ya nomino: kitabu ambacho, mwalimu ambaye.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.

example.question: "Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umewahi kumsamehe rafiki aliyekukosea?" inasomwa vipi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Ala, kumbe ninyi ni ndugu!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?

example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks the voice should stay the same through a happy and a sad part.

example.question: Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.help: A sentence to one child with the plural pronoun among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.feedback: Wewe ni mmoja, ninyi ni wengi. Mimi ni mmoja, sisi ni wengi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.error: Uses a different person in the verb from the pronoun (Mimi anasoma, Sisi wanacheza).

example.question: Jaza: Sisi ___ (cheza) mpira.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.feedback: Kiambishi cha kitenzi hupatana na nafsi: sisi tunacheza.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.error: Adds a prefix to six, seven, nine or ten (Wasita walifika).

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_B.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses li- with a ma- noun because it starts with ma- (maji limeisha).

example.question: Maji ___meisha kisimani.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child learned that ma- goes with li-, which is true only for the plural of nouns that have a singular.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maji ___meisha kisimani." with "li" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: Ask "Je, kuna neno jiji, au jimaji?" Maji has no singular.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Maji ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA. Hupatana na ya-: maji yameisha.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses u-, i-, zi- or vi- with a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child uses the prefix of the class he knows best.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "i" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- tu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses a- as for a person or animal (maziwa ameichacha).

example.question: Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child treats the noun like a living thing.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "a" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: A gap with a- among the options for a thing noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: A- ni ya watu na wanyama. Maziwa ni kitu, na hupatana na ya-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Picks a noun of another class as a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child cannot yet tell YA-YA nouns by their agreement.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?" with "kitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- na hazina umoja, kama maji.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Gives the opposite lesson (Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa: one person is enough).

example.question: Maana ya "Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa" ni?
example.wrong_answer: mtu mmoja anaweza kufanya kazi yote

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child reads "hakivunji" quickly and misses the negative.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: The question "Maana ya "Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa" ni?" with "mtu mmoja anaweza kufanya kazi yote" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Read the methali slowly and mark the negative word; say what one finger cannot do.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Methali hii inafunza ushirikiano: mtu mmoja hawezi peke yake.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Gives the name of another kind of poem for the number of lines (tathlitha for tathnia).

example.question: Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child has the names but not the numbers behind them.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___." with "tathlitha" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: The number of lines asked with all three names among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Tathnia ni mishororo miwili, tathlitha mitatu na tarbia minne. Jina linaonyesha idadi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Names the kind of a stanza shown without counting its lines.

example.question: Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child guesses from the look of the stanza.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."" with "tathlitha" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: A short stanza with the three names among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Hesabu mishororo kwanza. Mistari miwili ni tathnia, mitatu ni tathlitha, minne ni tarbia.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Swaps ukwapi (the first part of a line) and utao (the second).

example.question: Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child knows the two names but not their order.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "utao" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Both names among the options for the first or the second part.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Mshororo hugawanyika katika sehemu mbili: ukwapi ni ya kwanza, utao ni ya pili.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Gives vina or mizani for the parts of a line.

example.question: Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child mixes the parts of a line with its sounds and counts.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "vina" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, na mizani ni silabi. Vipande vya mshororo ni ukwapi na utao.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a text that describes a person (wasifu) for a story (masimulizi).

example.question: Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: Both kinds can mention a person.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: Short texts: one describing a person, one telling events.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Ask whether the text tells what happened in order, or tells who someone is.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a text that explains how something is done (maelezo) for a story.

example.question: Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: The child sees a sequence in both.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: A recipe-like text and a story.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Ask whether the writer says "what happened" or "how to do it".
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu. Masimulizi husimulia tukio lililotokea.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a story of events for a description of a person.

example.question: Kifungu kinasimulia kilichotokea Jumamosi kijijini. Ni insha ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: A story has a person in it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: A story about a person doing things.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Does the text tell events in order?
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Wasifu humwelezea mtu mwenyewe.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "Umoja ni mzuri." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.wrong_answer: tatua migogoro kwa amani, heshimu tamaduni, shirikiana katika kazi, wakaribishe wageni
example.correct_answer: wakaribishe wageni, shirikiana katika kazi, heshimu tamaduni, tatua migogoro kwa amani

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "tatua migogoro kwa amani, heshimu tamaduni, shirikiana katika kazi, wakaribishe wageni" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a maelezo of how to do something for a wasifu, or a wasifu for a maelezo.

example.question: Matini inayoanza "Kwanza, chukua jembe..." ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: Both describe; the child does not ask whether it describes a thing or explains how to do something.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: The question "Matini inayoanza "Kwanza, chukua jembe..." ni ya aina gani?" with "wasifu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Ask: does it describe how something is (wasifu) or how it is done (maelezo)?
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.feedback: Maelezo hufafanua jinsi ya kufanya jambo; wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.error: Uses ya- or zi- with a U-U noun as if it had a plural (uji yametiwa).

example.question: Uji ___metiwa sukari.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.cause: The child assumes every noun can be many.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.reveals: The question "Uji ___metiwa sukari." with "ya" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.help: Ask "Je, tunasema ujiuji? Uji una wingi?" It has none.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.feedback: Nomino za U-U hazina wingi, kwa hiyo hupatana na u- tu: uji umetiwa sukari.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.error: Uses i-, li- or another prefix with a U-U noun.

example.question: Ugali ___meiva sasa.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.cause: The child uses the prefix of a class he knows better.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.reveals: The question "Ugali ___meiva sasa." with "i" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.feedback: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u-: ugali umeiva.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.error: Picks a noun of another class as a U-U noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.cause: The child cannot yet tell U-U nouns by their agreement.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?" with "kitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.feedback: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u- na hazina wingi, kama uji.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M_UU_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.error: Gives a U-U noun a ma- plural (umoja -> maumoja, uji -> mauji).

example.question: Wingi wa "umoja" ni upi?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.cause: U-YA nouns like ugonjwa/magonjwa teach the child that u- nouns take ma-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "umoja" ni upi?" with "maumoja" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.help: Test: can you count it? Umoja, uji, ugali are not counted; they stay U-U.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.feedback: Nomino za U-U hazina wingi: umoja wetu, uji umepikwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_U.U_U.M6_UU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.error: Says the target sound of the poem as the close sound (nchi as chi, ng'ombe as gombe) while reciting.

example.question: Neno "njia" katika shairi linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.cause: The nasal is quick and the child drops it when reciting fast.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.reveals: The question "Neno "njia" katika shairi linatamkwa vipi?" with "jia" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.help: Slow the line down; say the nasal clearly, then speed up.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.feedback: Tamka sauti ya pua wazi: njia, si jia.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.error: Takes a line about equal roles literally (both must do the same job every day).

example.question: Shairi linasema: "Kazi ya nyumba si ya mama peke yake." Maana yake ni?
example.correct_answer: wote nyumbani, wake kwa waume, washiriki kazi

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.cause: The child reads the negative as a rule against the mother.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.reveals: The question "Shairi linasema: "Kazi ya nyumba si ya mama peke yake." Maana yake ni?" with "mama asifanye kazi ya nyumba" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.help: Restate the line in a positive sentence together.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.feedback: Shairi linafunza kwamba kazi ni ya wote.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.error: Gives the everyday meaning of a word where the poem uses a figurative one (bega as the shoulder only, where it means support).

example.question: "Tushikane bega kwa bega." Maana ya "bega kwa bega" ni?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.cause: The child knows the body word and does not test it against the line.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.reveals: The question ""Tushikane bega kwa bega." Maana ya "bega kwa bega" ni?" with "kugusa mabega" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.help: Read the line with each meaning in place; keep the one that makes sense.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.feedback: Bega kwa bega hapa ni kushirikiana pamoja kwa usawa.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.error: Answers a question about the poem from his own view, not from the poem.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini wasichana na wavulana wasome wote?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu elimu ni haki ya kila mtoto

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.cause: The topic is one the child has views on.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.reveals: The question "Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini wasichana na wavulana wasome wote?" with "kwa sababu wazazi wanataka" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.help: Ask for the line that gives the answer.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.feedback: Jibu kutokana na maneno ya shairi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.SHAIRI_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Chooses an article by its length or colour, not by its topic and his reading level.

example.question: Ni kigezo kipi bora cha kuchagua makala maktabani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: Nobody has named the criteria; the child picks what looks impressive.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Ni kigezo kipi bora cha kuchagua makala maktabani?" with "makala marefu zaidi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: List criteria together (mada, kiwango, mwandishi, tarehe) and use them on three real articles.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Chagua makala kwa mada yake na kiwango cha lugha.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Chooses an old article for news that changes (last year's statistics) without looking at the date.

example.question: Unatafuta habari mpya kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia shuleni. Uangalie nini kwanza?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: The child does not know information goes out of date.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari mpya kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia shuleni. Uangalie nini kwanza?" with "picha ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Compare two articles on the same topic from different years.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Kwa habari mpya, angalia tarehe ya makala.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Gives an example in the article as its main point.

example.question: Wazo kuu la makala "Wasichana Katika Sayansi" ni lipi?
example.correct_answer: Wasichana na wavulana wanaweza kufaulu katika sayansi.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: The example is a little story and stays in memory.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Wazo kuu la makala "Wasichana Katika Sayansi" ni lipi?" with "Akinyi alishinda tuzo ya sayansi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Ask: is this the point, or a case that shows the point?
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Mfano huonyesha wazo kuu; si wazo kuu lenyewe.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Takes the writer's opinion for a fact, or a fact for an opinion.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni maoni ya mwandishi?
example.wrong_answer: Shule yetu ina wanafunzi mia tano.
example.correct_answer: Shule yetu ndiyo bora zaidi nchini.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: Both are stated in the article with the same confidence.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni maoni ya mwandishi?" with "Shule yetu ina wanafunzi mia tano." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Ask: can it be checked? A fact can; an opinion is what someone thinks.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Maoni ni kile mtu anachofikiri; ukweli unaweza kuthibitishwa.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.error: Names the wrong part of the insha (puts the ending in the introduction).

example.question: Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.cause: The child knows the names of the parts but not their order.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.reveals: The question "Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___." with "utangulizi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.help: A part asked by its place (first, middle, last) with all the names among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.feedback: Insha ina kichwa juu, kisha utangulizi (mwanzo), mwili (katikati) na hitimisho (mwisho).
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?" with "Dada yangu ni mzuri." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Ana mikono mrefu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Dada Yangu Mhandisi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Dada Yangu Mhandisi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Dada Yangu Mhandisi" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Insha "Dada Yangu Mhandisi" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.error: Puts all the detail in the utangulizi and leaves the kiini with one line.

example.question: Utangulizi wa insha ya wasifu hufanya nini?
example.correct_answer: humtambulisha mtu au kitu kwa ufupi

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.cause: The child starts with everything he knows and runs out for the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.reveals: The question "Utangulizi wa insha ya wasifu hufanya nini?" with "hueleza sifa zote za mtu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.help: Plan: utangulizi one or two sentences; kiini a paragraph for each feature.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.feedback: Utangulizi hutambulisha kwa ufupi; kiini hueleza sifa kwa kina.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.error: Describes features in no order (face, job, eyes, home, hair), so the picture is broken.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi bora wa kiini cha wasifu wa mtu?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.cause: The child writes features as they come to mind.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi bora wa kiini cha wasifu wa mtu?" with "macho, kazi, nywele, nyumbani, uso" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.help: Group features: appearance, character, work; one paragraph each.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.feedback: Panga sifa kwa makundi: sura, tabia, kazi.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.error: Ends without a hitimisho that sums up why the person or thing matters.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika wasifu wa mwalimu wako?
example.correct_answer: Kwa sababu ya bidii yake, mwalimu wetu ni kielelezo chema kwetu sote.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.cause: The child stops when the features run out.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika wasifu wa mwalimu wako?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.help: Ask: what do you want the reader to remember about this person?
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga kwa kueleza umuhimu wa mtu au kitu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.MUUNDO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.error: Uses zi- with an I-I noun as if it were a plural (afya zimeimarika).

example.question: Afya ___meimarika baada ya matibabu.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.cause: The child ties i- and zi- together as the pair for one and many.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.reveals: The question "Afya ___meimarika baada ya matibabu." with "zi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.help: Ask "Je, tunasema afyaafya? Afya ni kitu cha kuhesabu?"
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.feedback: Nomino za I-I hazihesabiki, kwa hiyo hupatana na i-: afya imeimarika.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.error: Uses u-, li- or another prefix with an I-I noun.

example.question: Njaa ___nauma tumboni.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.cause: The child uses the prefix of a class he knows better.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.reveals: The question "Njaa ___nauma tumboni." with "u" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.feedback: Nomino za I-I hupatana na i-: njaa inauma.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.error: Picks a noun of another class as an I-I noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya I-I?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.cause: The child cannot yet tell I-I nouns by their agreement.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya I-I?" with "kitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.feedback: Nomino za I-I ni hali au mawazo yasiyohesabika, kama afya na njaa.
