KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.error: Treats an I-I noun as I-ZI and gives it zi- in a "plural" (sukari zimeisha).

example.question: Jaza: Sukari ___ (isha).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.cause: Most n- nouns the child knows are I-ZI with a zi- plural.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.reveals: The question "Jaza: Sukari ___ (isha)." with "zimeisha" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.help: Test: can you count it? Sukari, chai, afya are not counted; they stay i-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.feedback: Nomino za I-I hazina wingi: sukari imeisha.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M6_II.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.error: Reads the nahau word for word.

example.question: "Kukata tamaa" maana yake ni nini?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.cause: The child does not know that a nahau has its own meaning.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.help: Ask whether anyone really cuts tamaa.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.feedback: Nahau ina maana tofauti na maneno yake. "Kukata tamaa" ni kuacha kuwa na matumaini.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.error: Gives the meaning of another nahau.

example.question: "Kula chumvi" maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: kuwa na umri mkubwa na uzoefu

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.cause: The child knows several nahau but swaps meanings.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: The meaning of another nahau as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.help: Ask what experience chumvi stands for.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.feedback: Kila nahau ina maana yake. "Kula chumvi" ni kuwa na uzoefu wa miaka mingi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.error: Completes the nahau with a different word (kukata moyo for kukata tamaa).

example.question: Usikate ___ ukishindwa mara moja.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.cause: The child remembers the shape but changes a word.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: A nahau gap where a near word is an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.feedback: Nahau hazibadiliki: kukata tamaa, kupiga moyo konde. Neno moja likibadilika, maana hupotea.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.error: Uses a nahau of work in a sentence where its meaning does not fit (Alijifunga kibwebwe kulala).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kujifunga kibwebwe" ipasavyo?
example.correct_answer: Alijifunga kibwebwe akamaliza kazi ya shamba.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.cause: The child knows the words, not the situation.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kujifunga kibwebwe" ipasavyo?" with "Alijifunga kibwebwe akalala." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.help: Say the meaning (to get ready to work hard) and test the sentence against it.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.feedback: Kujifunga kibwebwe ni kujiandaa kufanya kazi kwa bidii.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M6_NAH_USE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukijiandaa mapema na kufuata maagizo, tunapunguza madhara ya majanga.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" ni upi?" with "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia?
example.wrong_answer: Maji yalifika kwenye madirisha ya nyumba.
example.correct_answer: Tukijiandaa mapema na kufuata maagizo, tunapunguza madhara ya majanga.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia?" with "Maji yalifika kwenye madirisha ya nyumba." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (tahadhari).

example.question: Katika matini: "Wanakijiji walipewa tahadhari kabla ya mvua kubwa kunyesha." Neno "tahadhari" lina maana gani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Wanakijiji walipewa tahadhari kabla ya mvua kubwa kunyesha." Neno "tahadhari" lina maana gani?" with "tarehe ya mkutano" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "tahadhari" hapa ni onyo la mapema kuhusu hatari.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "Moto ni hatari." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.wrong_answer: jua njia ya kutoka, usiache taa ikiwaka, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, zima jiko
example.correct_answer: zima jiko, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, usiache taa ikiwaka, jua njia ya kutoka

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "jua njia ya kutoka, usiache taa ikiwaka, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, zima jiko" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.error: Uses the wrong one of pa-, ku-, mu- for the place (kule pana).

example.question: Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.cause: The child does not read the word of place (pale, kule, humu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "pana" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.help: A sentence with pale, kule or humu and all three forms among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.feedback: Pale huchukua pa-, kule huchukua ku-, humu na mle huchukua mu- (m-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.error: Uses the prefix of the noun (una, ina) where the place needs pa-, ku- or mu-.

example.question: Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.cause: The child follows the noun and not the place.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "ina" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.help: Options with u- and i- forms.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.feedback: Katika ngeli ya mahali, kitenzi hupatana na mahali (pa-, ku-, mu-), si na nomino.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.error: Uses the noun's own prefix with a place noun in -ni (nyumbani imesafishwa for nyumbani kumesafishwa).

example.question: Jaza: Shuleni ___ (safishwa).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.cause: The child sees the noun shule (I-ZI) and keeps its prefix.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.reveals: The question "Jaza: Shuleni ___ (safishwa)." with "imesafishwa" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.help: A place in -ni moves to PA-KU-MU: shuleni pa- (exact place), ku- (general), mu- (inside).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.feedback: Mahali (-ni) huchukua pa-, ku- au mu-: shuleni kumesafishwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.error: Uses ku- or pa- for inside a thing where mu- is needed (ndani ya nyumba kuna giza for mna giza).

example.question: Jaza: Ndani ya chumba ___ giza.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.cause: Kuna is the common "there is" and the child uses it everywhere.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.reveals: The question "Jaza: Ndani ya chumba ___ giza." with "pana" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.help: Act: inside a box (mu-), at a spot (pa-), around/far (ku-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.feedback: Ndani ya kitu tunatumia mu-: chumbani mna giza.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.

example.question: Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.cause: The child links furaha and huzuni because they go together.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.reveals: A synonym question with the opposite as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.help: Ask whether the two words mean the same.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.feedback: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.error: Picks a word about the same topic but with a different meaning.

example.question: Kisawe cha "huzuni" ni ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.cause: The child picks what goes with the word, not what means the same.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.reveals: A related word as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.help: Could you swap the two words in a sentence and keep the same meaning?
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.feedback: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.error: Picks a group that has one opposite or unrelated word among the synonyms.

example.question: Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.cause: The child checks the first words of the group and not every word.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.reveals: The question "Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?" with "bashasha, huzuni, raha, tabasamu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.help: A group with three synonyms and one opposite.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.feedback: Kila neno la kundi lazima liwe na maana sawa. Huzuni ni kinyume cha furaha.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

example.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child reads a play as a story.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play with brackets and spoken lines.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Brackets tell the actor what to do, not what to say.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Does not tell a play from a story.

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child sees a short text and does not look at the form.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play and a story on the same event.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Look for the speaker names with a colon.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives a character who did not say the line.

example.question: Nani alisema "Nitakuletea maji"?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child does not follow the names before the colons.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Find the line and read the name before it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives a wrong detail of the play (the place, the thing bought).

example.question: Akinyi alienda wapi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child remembers a place named near the question.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A where-or-what question with another detail of the play.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Find the line where it is said.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives the wrong meaning of a word in the play.

example.question: Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child guesses from the look of the word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A meaning question for a word in the play.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Read the line where the word is used and think who goes with whom.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: Kasa ni mnyama anayeishi majini kwa miaka mingi.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Kasa ni mnyama anayeishi majini kwa miaka mingi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: Tunamwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Tunamwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: kasa aliogelea baharini, tulikata nyavu, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulimwona kasa
example.correct_answer: tulimwona kasa, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulikata nyavu, kasa aliogelea baharini

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "kasa aliogelea baharini, tulikata nyavu, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulimwona kasa" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes what a character said without the alama za usemi and the comma (Mama alisema njoo hapa).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Speech is written as the child hears it, with no sign of where the words begin and end.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Mama alisema njoo hapa haraka." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Underline the exact words said; put them inside the marks, with a comma before and a capital inside.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Maneno halisi ya msemaji huwekwa ndani ya alama za usemi: "Njoo hapa."
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.error: Keeps the simple verb where a longer form is needed (hupika for hupikiana).

example.question: Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.cause: The child reads the verb and not what the sentence says about who does it for whom.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.reveals: The question "Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)" with "hupika" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.help: Ask "Nani anampikia nani?" If each cooks for the other, the verb needs -ana.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.feedback: Kitenzi cha kawaida hakionyeshi kwamba kila mmoja anamtendea mwenzake. Kutendeana: hupikiana.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.error: Uses the verb for one doing it for another (hupikia) where each does it for the other (hupikiana).

example.question: Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.reveals: The question "Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi." with "huandikia" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.help: A sentence in which two people do the same for each other.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.error: Picks a verb form that does not fit the meaning (huandikisha for huandikiana).

example.question: Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.cause: The child mixes the endings -ana, -isha and -ua.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.reveals: The question "Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)" with "huimbiana" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.help: Options with each ending and a gloss in brackets.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.feedback: -ana ni kila mmoja kwa mwenzake, -isha ni kumfanya mtu atende, na -ua ni kufanya kinyume.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.error: Makes the reversive (kutendua) of any verb with -ua, even where it does not exist (kulaua, kusomua).

example.question: Kauli ya kutendua ya "funga" ni?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.cause: Funga/fungua and vaa/vua make -ua look like a rule for all verbs.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.reveals: The question "Kauli ya kutendua ya "funga" ni?" with "fungana" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.help: Keep a list of real reversives (funga/fungua, choma/chomoa, ziba/zibua); test new ones in the dictionary.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.feedback: Kutendua hubadilisha tendo kuwa kinyume chake: funga -> fungua; si kila kitenzi kina kutendua.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Calls formal language informal, or informal language formal.

example.question: "Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child does not look at who is speaking to whom.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question ""Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___." with "rasmi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A greeting between friends and a greeting to a leader.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Lugha rasmi ni ya heshima na ya viongozi. Lugha isiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki na nyumbani.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses slang or casual words with a teacher, a leader or at a meeting.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu mkuu, naomba ruhusa ya kuondoka mapema.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child uses the way he talks to friends everywhere.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu." with "Nipe ruhusa tu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A request to a leader with a casual version among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa mwalimu, kiongozi au mkutano rasmi tunatumia maneno ya heshima.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses very formal words with a friend or a sister at home.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child thinks formal words are always better.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani." with "Naomba kibali cha kuanza mchezo." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A friendly invitation next to a formal one.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa rafiki au ndugu nyumbani, lugha ya kawaida inafaa. Lugha rasmi kupita kiasi inasikika ya ajabu.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Speaks on the phone to an official as to a friend (Sema!, Uko wapi?) with no greeting or name.

example.question: Unampigia simu mwalimu mkuu. Unaanza vipi?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo mwalimu mkuu? Ni mimi Amina wa darasa la sita.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: Phone talk with friends is the model the child knows.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Unampigia simu mwalimu mkuu. Unaanza vipi?" with "Sema! Uko wapi?" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Role-play a phone call: greet, say who you are, say why you call, thank, take leave.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa simu rasmi: salimu, jitambulishe, eleza sababu, shukuru.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya ya akili. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya ya akili. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukizungumza na mtu tunayemwamini, tunapunguza mawazo mazito.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" ni upi?" with "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya ya akili?
example.wrong_answer: Zawadi alikaa chini ya mti peke yake.
example.correct_answer: Tukizungumza na mtu tunayemwamini, tunapunguza mawazo mazito.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya ya akili?" with "Zawadi alikaa chini ya mti peke yake." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (msongo).

example.question: Katika matini: "Msongo wa mawazo ulimfanya Zawadi akose usingizi." Neno "msongo" lina maana gani?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Msongo wa mawazo ulimfanya Zawadi akose usingizi." Neno "msongo" lina maana gani?" with "msitu mnene" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "msongo" hapa ni mawazo mengi yanayomlemea mtu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "Mawazo ni mabaya." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.wrong_answer: omba msaada wa mshauri, lala vya kutosha, cheza au fanya mazoezi, zungumza na mtu
example.correct_answer: zungumza na mtu, cheza au fanya mazoezi, lala vya kutosha, omba msaada wa mshauri

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "omba msaada wa mshauri, lala vya kutosha, cheza au fanya mazoezi, zungumza na mtu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Repeats the word as its own opposite.

example.question: Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child does not read the word lakini that signals a contrast.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___." with "mzito" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: A sentence with lakini and the same word among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Kinyume ni neno la maana ya upande wa pili, si neno lilelile.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Picks a different adjective that is not the opposite (mdogo for mfupi).

example.question: Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child picks a word from the same field (size) without checking it is the exact opposite.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___." with "mdogo" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: A word with a near neighbour of meaning among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi. Mdogo ni kinyume cha mkubwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Gives the opposite without the prefix of the noun (refu for mrefu, jinga for mjinga).

example.question: Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child changes the opposite to fit the noun when it does not change, or leaves out the prefix when it must.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___." with "kilaini" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: Options with and without the prefix.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Vivumishi vingi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino (mjinga, wachache). Vingine hubaki kama vilivyo (laini, moto).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Makes the opposite with si- or "si" (si mrefu for mfupi).

example.question: Kinyume cha "mrefu" ni?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: Negation is a quick way to say "not", so the child uses it as the opposite.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "mrefu" ni?" with "si mrefu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: An opposite is another adjective: mrefu/mfupi, mpana/mwembamba.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Kinyume cha kivumishi ni kivumishi kingine: mfupi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Names the wrong animal for the behaviour (kobe for a hard worker).

example.question: Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child does not link the animal with the behaviour it stands for.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___." with "kobe" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A behaviour with several animals among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Kila mnyama hutumika kuonyesha tabia: nyuki (bidii), simba (ujasiri), kobe (polepole), kinyonga (kubadilika), mbweha (ujanja), tausi (kujionyesha).
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Takes a sentence with kama (a tashbihi) for a sitiari.

example.question: Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child does not tell the two figures apart.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ni kama simba." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A sitiari and a tashbihi on the same subject.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia "kama". Sitiari husema moja ni lingine bila "kama".
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Takes the sitiari word for word (the teacher really has a lion).

example.question: Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child reads the sentence as a plain statement.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ana simba." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A sitiari beside a sentence with the verb kuwa na.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Sitiari haisemi mtu ana mnyama. Inasema mtu ni mnyama kwa tabia yake.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Uses a sitiari whose animal stands for another trait (Amina ni fisi for a kind girl).

example.question: Ni sitiari ipi inamfaa mtu mkarimu?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child knows the pattern X ni Y but not what each animal stands for.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Ni sitiari ipi inamfaa mtu mkarimu?" with "Yeye ni fisi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: Use the folk-tale chart: fisi - ulafi, sungura - ujanja, njiwa - upole, simba - ushujaa.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Fisi huwakilisha ulafi; njiwa huwakilisha upole.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Usalama wa Jamii" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Usalama wa Jamii" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Usalama wa Jamii"

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Usalama wa Jamii" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Usalama wa Jamii" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi tafadhali

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi tafadhali" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: Ugaidi ni tishio kwa usalama wa nchi.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Ugaidi ni tishio kwa usalama wa nchi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: Mlinzi anaona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Mlinzi anaona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: mfuko ulikaguliwa, polisi walifika, aliwaonya watu, mlinzi aliona mfuko
example.correct_answer: mlinzi aliona mfuko, aliwaonya watu, polisi walifika, mfuko ulikaguliwa

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "mfuko ulikaguliwa, polisi walifika, aliwaonya watu, mlinzi aliona mfuko" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Uses a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) where a condition marker (-ki-, -nge-) is needed.

example.question: ___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child knows tenses and not the condition marker.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani." with "Ulisoma" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A sentence with if in the meaning and tense forms among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Sharti linaonyeshwa kwa -ki-, -sipo- au -nge-, si kwa -li-, -na- au -ta-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Uses -sipo- (do not) where the condition is to do (-ki-).

example.question: Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child does not read the whole sentence for meaning.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka." with "wasipofanya" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A condition whose result only makes sense if it is positive.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Soma sentensi nzima. Kama matokeo ni mazuri, sharti ni la kufanya (-ki-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Names the tense marker (-ta-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child finds a marker in the verb but picks the wrong one.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?" with "-ta-" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A sentence with both -ki- and -ta- and both in the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Ta- huonyesha wakati ujao. Ki- huonyesha sharti.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Names the person prefix (u-, a-, ni-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child picks the first marker in the verb.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?" with "-a-" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A verb with a person prefix and a condition marker.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Kiambishi cha mtu (u-, a-, ni-) hakionyeshi sharti. Sharti ni -ki-, -sipo-, -nge-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..error: Gives a detail of the narration as its message.

example.question: Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru. Ujumbe wake ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukilipa ushuru, serikali hutujengea huduma kama barabara na shule.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..cause: The detail was vivid; the child has not asked what the whole narration teaches.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..reveals: The question "Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru. Ujumbe wake ni upi?" with "Barabara mpya ilikuwa ya lami." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..help: After listening, ask: what did the speaker want us to learn? Then: what is one thing that happened?
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..error: Retells the events in a mixed order, starting with the most exciting part.

example.question: Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..cause: The child jumps to the part that impressed him most.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..reveals: The question "Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?" with "sehemu ya kusisimua zaidi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..help: Retell with three fingers: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..feedback: Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..error: Uses gestures or a face that do not match the words (smiles while telling a sad part, stands still for an action).

example.question: Unasimulia: "Tuliiona barabara ndefu ikinyooka hadi mjini!" Ishara ipi inafaa?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..cause: The child is nervous and does not link the body to the words.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..reveals: The question "Unasimulia: "Tuliiona barabara ndefu ikinyooka hadi mjini!" Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kukunja mikono kifuani" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..help: Mirror game in pairs: one says a line, the other shows the feeling; swap.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..feedback: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..error: Mixes English or Sheng into the telling (Then tukaenda..., ilikuwa poa sana).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?
example.wrong_answer: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
example.correct_answer: Kisha tukaenda nyumbani; ilikuwa siku nzuri sana.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..cause: The child narrates as he talks with friends.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?" with "Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..help: Record a telling; play it back; the child finds the non-Kiswahili words and replaces them.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..feedback: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..error: Tells a story that is not on the topic given (ushuru (taxes)).

example.question: Mada ni ushuru (taxes). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?
example.correct_answer: Siku wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..cause: The child tells the story he knows best, whatever the topic.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..reveals: The question "Mada ni ushuru (taxes). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?" with "Siku nilipotazama mechi ya mpira" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..help: Write the topic on the board; before telling, the child says in one sentence how his story fits it.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T11_KUJIELEZA_KWA_UFASAH..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara."?
example.wrong_answer: Serikali ... hutumia ... ushuru ... kujenga ... hospitali, ... shule ... na ... barabara.
example.correct_answer: Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara."?" with "Serikali ... hutumia ... ushuru ... kujenga ... hospitali, ... shule ... na ... barabara." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, unajua ushuru hulipwa wapi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, unajua ushuru hulipwa wapi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Hongera, umelipa ushuru kwa wakati!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umelipa ushuru kwa wakati!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (serikali read as selikali).

example.question: Neno "serikali" linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "serikali" linatamkwa vipi?" with "selikali" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Tamka "serikali" kama lilivyoandikwa; "selikali" ni neno jingine au si neno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kuelimishwa kuhusu ushuru?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA KUELIMISHWA KUHUSU USHURU

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kuelimishwa kuhusu ushuru?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_RASMI.KUANDIKA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..error: Only puts si- in front and keeps -ki- (Usikisoma for Usiposoma).

example.question: Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..cause: The child applies the rule for negating a command or a tense to the conditional.
